title: Property and Casualty Rate Reviews - Texas Department of Insurance
claims: TDI states that like most other states, Texas is a file-and-use state, which means that once an insurer files its rates, it can use them on their effective date.

TDI states that if the commissioner disapproves a rate filing, the insurer can request a hearing, and that the request must be made in writing within 30 days of the effective date in the disapproval order.
